noAccounts: No active accounts are linked to you.
title: Admin Portal
usersHelp: Users appear after signing in and opening account access. Check issuer and subject before assigning privileges.
subject: Subject: {{subject}}
selfRestriction: Another administrator must change your roles or active status.
errorForbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
errorConflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errorInvalid: Check your entries and try again.
errorRequest: The request failed. Please try again.
criticalPermissionPolicy: To prevent lockout, admin.manage remains assigned only to Admin and cannot be edited here.
unsavedPermissions: You have unsaved permission changes. Save or cancel before refreshing or registering permissions.
registerPermissionHelp: Register this compiled permission? This does not grant it to any role.
permissionChangesHelp: These changes affect every user assigned to the selected roles. Review before confirming.
emailNoDelivery: Automatic delivery is inactive. Creating connectors and testing connections sends no email.
emailGmailSetup: Gmail authorization requires an operator-provisioned OAuth client, private credential directory and a separate notification encryption key.
emailImmutableSender: Sender and region are fixed. Create a new connector to change them; queued jobs keep their original connector.
emailSESIdentity: SES uses the AWS SDK credential chain. Verify this sender or its exact domain in the selected region. No AWS access keys are stored here.
emailSandbox: This SES account is in the sandbox. Production access is required before enabling this onboarding connector.
emailTestExplanation: This test checks authorization, sender readiness and available SES quota. It sends no email and does not prove inbox delivery.
emailScopeWarning: Google requires gmail.settings.basic to inspect sender identities. This scope also permits basic mailbox-setting changes; VGCA only reads send-as settings. No domain-wide delegation is required.
emailScopeConsent: I approve the displayed Gmail sending and sender-settings scopes.
emailUnsaved: Keep this form open or explicitly discard these unsaved changes.
emailConflict: Configuration changed. Inspect the latest record and review before submitting again.
emailInvalid: Check the required fields, sender, region and sending limits.
emailUncertain: The result is uncertain. Inspect the authoritative connector and audit history before another write. No automatic retry occurred.
emailUnavailable: Connector management is unavailable. Check provider readiness and deployment configuration.
emailDenied: An active administrator with current OIDC access and admin.manage is required.
emailTestCompleted: Connection test completed. Review its readiness result; no email was sent.
emailAuthorizationStarted: Authorization prepared. Continue with Google in a new tab, then refresh this list.
emailOAuthReturn: Review the connector readiness below. Authorization does not prove email delivery.
